Self.Wiki: An item pickup. The treasure places the items of its item lot as a pickup at the treasure part (an asset such as a container). Taking it awards the lot and sets the lot's Get Item Flag, after which the pickup no longer appears.

TreasurePartName.Wiki: The part the pickup is placed at, normally an Asset or Dummy Asset. With no part, no pickup appears.

ItemLotID.Wiki: The ItemLotParam row given by the treasure.

ActionButtonID.Wiki: An ActionButtonParam row for the pickup prompt. Retail values are ActionButtonParam rows, or 0 on about a fifth of the treasures.

PickupAnimID.Wiki: The pickup animation. 100 on every retail treasure.

InChest.Wiki: If ON, the item is inside a container. 40 of 95 retail treasures use it.

StartDisabled.Wiki: If ON, the pickup is placed hidden and can't be taken until something enables it. About half of the retail treasures use it.
